description.summary: This spell functions like Water , except it deals 5d6 points of water damage + your casting modifier (Intelligence or Charisma) + 1 point per caster level (maximum +15) and inflicts the Drenched status effect for 1d8 rounds.
description.value: This spell functions like Water , except it deals 5d6 points of water damage + your casting modifier (Intelligence or Charisma) + 1 point per caster level (maximum +15) and inflicts the Drenched status effect for 1d8 rounds. A successful Fortitude save prevents the status effect from taking effect.
